sources.name: Fortune 500 (2025) - fortune.com official ranking page, embedded JSON dataset
sources.note: Primary/authoritative source. Data extracted from the page's Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ JSON payload (props.pageProps.franchiseSearch.items), which contains Fortune's full underlying dataset for the list (a superset spanning the Fortune 1000, filtered here to rank<=500). Revenue figures are FY2024 revenue as published by Fortune for the 2025 ranking (71st annual list, announced June 2, 2025; Walmart #1 at $680,985M).

sources.name: Wikipedia - List of Fortune 500 companies (redirects to 'List of largest companies in the United States by revenue')
sources.note: Used to confirm list-year identity (Walmart $680,985M / rank 1 match) and as a sanity check for top-100 rows. Wikipedia's table only covers ranks 1-100, so it could not be used as the primary source for the full 500.

sources.name: Salt Technologies AI - Fortune 500 Companies Directory 2025 (mirror)
sources.note: Third-party mirror used ONLY for a 10-row random cross-check against the fortune.com primary source, not as a data source for the output records. 7/10 sampled rows matched exactly; the remainder showed minor revenue discrepancies (largest ~$1.2B on a company with ~$39B revenue, i.e. a few percent) consistent with this being an independently-compiled/LLM-assisted mirror rather than a transcription of the same primary figures. Not used to override any fortune.com values.

meta.geocode_note: Mayfield Village, OH (Progressive Corporation HQ) is a distinct incorporated village in Cuyahoga County, absent from us_places.csv (which only has the separate towns 'Mayfield' and 'Mayfield Heights'). Coordinates from en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mayfield,_Ohio (village-level, consistent with town-level precision used elsewhere in this dataset).

Abbott Park, IL (Abbott Laboratories HQ) is an unincorporated corporate-campus locality in Lake County (per Abbott's own FAQ: 'a suburb 40 miles north of Chicago'), not a Census place, so it is absent from us_places.csv. Coordinates (42.3005, -87.8947 / 42°18'3"N 87°53'41"W) from wikimapia.org listing for the Abbott Laboratories headquarters facility.

meta.geocode_note: Antioch, TN (LKQ Corporation HQ) is an unincorporated Nashville neighborhood in Davidson County, not independently in us_places.csv under TN (only CA and IL 'Antioch' entries exist there). Coordinates from en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Antioch,_Tennessee (neighborhood-level).
